'''Xander''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] officer who served in the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], he helped [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Chornarov]] [[Cademimu uprising|seize power]] on [[Cademimu V]].
